The '''1977–78 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], two points ahead of [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]]. [[Ayr United F.C.|Ayr United]] and [[Clydebank F.C. (1965)|Clydebank]] were relegated.
